description.zh:
开通服务的计费类型。取值：

- **PayByTraffic**：按流量计费
- **PayByBandwidth**：按带宽峰值
description.en:
The billing method for the service. Valid values:

- **PayByTraffic**: pay-by-data-transfer
- **PayByBandwidth**: pay-by-peak-bandwidth

description.zh:
开通服务的Websocket计费类型。取值：

- **websockettraffic**：按流量计费
- **websocketbps**：按带宽峰值
description.en:
The billing method for the WebSocket service. Valid values:

- **websockettraffic**: pay-by-data-transfer
- **websocketbps**: pay-by-peak-bandwidth

descriptions.zh:
>- 一个用户只能开通一次，且要求阿里云账号已通过实名认证。
>- 单用户调用频率：5次/秒。
descriptions.en:
> - You can activate DCDN only once per Alibaba Cloud account. Your account must have completed real-name authentication.
> - The call frequency is limited to 5 calls per second per user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn open-dcdn-service --bill-type PayByTraffic --websocket-bill-type websockettraffic --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn OpenDcdnService --region cn-hangzhou --BillType PayByTraffic --WebsocketBillType websockettraffic
